title: Ring Doorbell
blurb: Modern doorbells announce a visitor and inform them they are being filmed, and this chime does both jobs in about a second. Half the internet now recognises it from viral porch footage — parcels vanishing, bears investigating bins, neighbours conducting themselves poorly at three in the morning. It carries a slightly different authority to the old ding-dong: somebody is at the door, and there will be a recording. Use it in edits to announce an arrival, or play it at home to make an entire room freeze and reach for a phone.
origin: The chime from Ring video doorbells, famous via viral doorbell-cam footage.
